data.gender_notes: Ipshita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Name Ipshita is originated from Sanskrit word 'Ipsita' which means 'desired of Hri' or 'established with the Goddess Hri'. Hri is another name of Goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of wisdom, knowledge, and learning. This name is believed to be bestowed with the blessings of the Goddess of wisdom and knowledge. The name Ipshita carries the meaning “Goddess Hri (wisdom) + Shita (established)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ipshita usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess hri (wisdom) + shita (established) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
